parameters.content: Heavy job. Calls the host-side ffmpeg QA worker (tools/qa_worker.js): playable, duration, 9:16, resolution, audio present/level, black/frozen frames, thumbnail generation+validation. NOT assessed (reported honestly): speaker framing, subtitles. Result gates automatic mode AND the final pre-publish gate. If the worker is down the job retries/dead-letters - content never skips QA.

parameters.query: SELECT j.job_id, j.job_type, j.entity_id, j.correlation_id, j.payload, j.attempt, ch.id AS channel_id, ch.name AS channel_name, ch.platforms, ch.clip_min_seconds, ch.clip_max_seconds, ch.rules, ch.timezone, ch.quality_threshold, n.name AS niche_name, n.keywords FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = NULLIF(j.payload->>'channel_id','')::uuid LEFT JOIN niches n ON n.id = ch.niche_id WHERE j.job_id = $1::uuid AND j.status = 'running'

SELECT cl.clip_id, cl.video_url, ch.clip_min_seconds, ch.clip_max_seconds, (ca_setting('qa_worker_url','"http://localhost:9100"'))#>>'{}' AS qa_url, (ca_setting('openshorts_base_url','"http://localhost:8000"'))#>>'{}' AS os_base FROM clips cl JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = $2::uuid WHERE cl.clip_id = $1::uuid

meta.note: Credentials are NOT embedded. After import, open each node showing a credential warning and select your own credential (see SETUP.md).
